title: Render Plan Validator
description: Add RenderPlanLimits struct and validate_ui_node to framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, call validation before render_ui_node and render_component_scene, add unit test for oversized payloads.
summary: The RenderPlanLimits struct and validate_ui_node/validate_component_scene wiring were already implemented (limits at framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs:3737, validate_component_scene:3787, validate_ui_node:4022, called before render_ui_node and render_component_scene with error widgets on rejection). This ticket's remaining gap was test coverage: added validate_component_scene_rejects_oversized_mesh_count, validate_ui_node_rejects_oversized_node_count, and validate_ui_node_rejects_oversized_tree_depth to the existing render_plan_validator_tests module (lib.rs ~4505), alongside the pre-existing oversized-JSON-payload test. All 4 tests pass via `cargo test -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu --lib render_plan_validator_tests`. No production code changes were needed; this closes out the validator work started in this ticket.
